notes.title: Version 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Fixes & Improvements

 Hides unit info in battles during tutorials
 Hides starter dice panel when sorting the units
 Updates re-roll prices to be based on total amount of items left
 Update small heal icon to be a smaller heart to contrast better with the half-heal icon

notes.title: Version 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Fixes & Updates


Fixes graphical artifacts when sorting bugs in the party selection scene.

Fixes particles not properly playing in the party selection scene.

Fixes unit info showing during tutorial in the party selection scene.

Ensures tutorial focuses on the unit in question in the party selection scene.

Fixes Elite battle rewards being less than normal battle rewards.

Fixes Lacewing ability shifting the unit into the wrong position. 

Fixes a bug where the save file could potentially lose reference to the party units causing it to break on reload. 

 Hidden stamp descriptions are now revealed when unlocked.

notes.title: Demo Version 2.1.3
notes.notes:
Fixes/Updates:

Optimizes Field and Actions guide (reduces slow downs when opening the book)

Adds language settings: English, Spanish, and Japanese (still a work in progress)

Adds warning that party units are a lost when ending a run

Tweaks bugs animations

Full Game:

Fixes repeat die not working when being used by the boss die

Fixes shiny boss conversions breaking boss die

Fixes Maps now unlocking new content after completing a run

Fixes broken achievements

notes.title: Demo Version 2.1.0
notes.notes:
Fixes/Updates:

Stats page completed

Fixes equipment not loading after a long run

Fixes Highest STR stat not showing the unit image

Fixes Previews not always clearing

Fixes Fastest Time stat not updating

Resetting progress also updates the Action page in the guide book

Adds unit sorting to the party selection

Minor graphics, visual effects, and animations fixes

Updates some unit abilities for better balancing



Full Game:

Adds new consumables

Adds new Starter Die that are unlocked through Expert Mode

Balances looting in Expert Mode

notes.title: Demo Version 2.0.5
notes.notes:
DEMO:

Adds an Actions page to the field guide.

Skipping loot/rewards now gives 1 coin.

Variants now give 3 coins on KO rather than 1.

Adds a tutorial for "Lost Units".

Updates how "Lowest HP" works.

Fixes some Boss Die faces not showing or working correctly.

Some minor difficulty & unit stat changes.

Some minor sound effect/visual polishes.



FULL GAME:

Adds new units.

Adds new dice & consumables.

Battle Hazards now contain a guaranteed variant unit.

Certain themes/items are now locked behind specific maps during your first run.

Repeat Die now show their action in their name rather than their description.

Fixes some steam achievements.

notes.title: Demo Version 1.1.5
notes.notes:
Fixes "Move" ability getting triggered when a unit is revived but the party did not move

Fixes the Start sfx playing twice when using controller on a brand new game

Adds leader icon to the map party

Updates some animations

notes.title: Demo Version 1.1.2
notes.notes:
Fixes UI getting cut off in 16:10 resolution.

Rearranges UI (settings button is now on the right)

Adds a preview icon to preview which unit will become the leader during movement.

Adds leader icons to the units in front.

Party members are no longer lost when ending a run from the Map scene.

Loot music has been updated.

Mixed rewards now always show up in the same order (dice, equipment, consumable)

Various small graphic & animation polishes and fixes.

notes.title: Demo Version 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Fixes & Updates:

New Ability!

Revive:  Resurrects a KO unit

Bottled units always go to the end of the line (behind dead units)

Additional tutorials added:

Run failed

Updates the potential support units that shows up with the boss

Fixes animation bug with Pill Bug Unit

notes.title: Demo Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Adds new "Scare" action for die faces and consumables.

Adds tutorials for Player Party and Run Completed.

Adds tutorial titles to the tutorial boxes.

Adds a notification animation to the shop once you are able to purchase an item.

Adds navigation to show which map you're currently on.

Adds a tooltip to the speed settings.

Elite & Boss units now drop more coins.

Consumables are now limited to 5, rather than 10.

The consumables bar is now fully shown, regardless of how many you have.

The first ever dice roll is now predetermined to help teach players.

Coin rewards have been removed from the tutorial battle.

Player dice no longer get grayed out when they are ineffective.

The difficulty curve has been slightly modified.

Fixes a bug where the KO animation was not always playing correctly on fast mode.

Fixes controller support breaking during loot

Fixes consumables not triggering a "Miss" when the action is unusable

notes.title: Demo Version 1.0.10
notes.notes:
Change Log[olist]
Updates enemy stats scaling for a better challenge

Updates map generation more interesting routes

Updates boss fights for an additional challenge

Unit stats have been re-balanced

Removes double and single unit battles in favor the more interesting three unit battles
[/olist]

Additions[olist]
Adds Elite Battles which offer a strong single unit battle with an additional challenge to overcome before they can be defeated

Adds a Tutorial Battle for first time players 




[/olist]
